youtube.title: Opposites Hop 🐰 Big and Small, Fast and Slow Song for Toddlers | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Hop and sing the opposites with Robo and Pip! A huge ball and a tiny ball bounce: big and small. A balloon floats up and a rock drops down: up and down. A drum goes boom and a little bell goes ting: loud and quiet. Bunny hops fast and Turtle walks slow: fast and slow. Point to the big ball, say the opposite (Robo says big, you say small!), play the hop-and-freeze game, fill the opposites tracker and hop along to the Opposites Hop chorus.

What your child learns: four pairs of opposites (big and small, up and down, loud and quiet, fast and slow), listening and answering with the opposite word, and moving with a song (stretch up big, curl up small, hop and freeze).

Sing at home: stretch up tall for big and curl up tiny for small, reach up high and touch your toes, clap loudly and then whisper, and hop fast like Bunny and walk slowly like Turtle. Play the freeze game together: hop, hop, hop... freeze! Then take turns: you say "big", your toddler says "small". Opposites Hop is an original song with original words and an original tune, written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.
